name: task-list-management
author: Anthropic and upstream contributors

license.scope: Clean plugin-level Apache-2.0 license applies; full recursive pinned tree shows no overriding license in selected folder. Original source and controlling license retained. External tools and linked works are not relicensed.
obligations: Include complete controlling Apache2 license and preserve attribution/copyright notices.
Preserve any applicable NOTICE text. No source changes proposed; Apache2 modification notices would apply only if changed later.
No trademark rights or third-party service rights are granted.

assignments.essential_function: Optional complete original productivity plugin for persistent tasks,memory,initialization and sync.
native_prerequisites: Original plugin layout,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and productivity command dispatch must be natively supplied.
Persistent working files and a browser supporting File System Access APIs for dashboard.
Connected data sources optional as authored; no rewriting paths,commands or instructions to simulate compatibility.
limitations: Current production AutoGPT support for these exact native prerequisites was not verified.
Kept outside main expert skills lists; do not present it as ready to install on AutoGPT.

review: Conditional unchanged native productivity bundle only. TASKS.md active/waiting/someday/done convention and confirmed task extraction are sound; automatic dashboard copy requires CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and its sibling dashboard file,plus original start/update references. Cannot claim current AutoGPT compatibility or replace these instructions.7.0K installs.
native_prerequisites: Writable persistent TASKS.md,CLAUDE.md,memory folder; user can open dashboard in a browser supporting File System Access APIs.
Original optional connectors for tracker/chat/email/calendar/docs; normal provisioning only,no dispatch wrappers or instruction overrides.
A stable shared working directory for TASKS.md, CLAUDE.md and memory/ that all four workflows use across sessions.
Ability to deliver/open dashboard.html in a browser with File System Access APIs against those same persistent files.
Use bundled sibling documents as instructions; no /productivity:* command handler is installed by this recipe.
original_native_prerequisites: Complete unchanged productivity plugin source/layout including all4skill files,skills/dashboard.html,CONNECTORS.md and clean child LICENSE.
Runtime must supply original CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and productivity command dispatch; current AutoGPT support is not verified.
Writable persistent TASKS.md,CLAUDE.md,memory folder; user can open dashboard in a browser supporting File System Access APIs.
Original optional connectors for tracker/chat/email/calendar/docs; normal provisioning only,no dispatch wrappers or instruction overrides.

dependency_decisions: Only the referenced startup/task/update chain is bundled; memory-management is included only as its own primary skill because startup already contains its complete memory bootstrap. No plugin metadata, README, unrelated skills or test fixtures are bundled.
runtime_blockers: The inspected platform drops user-invocable:false. Preserve this flag and require an explicit runtime/background-loading decision; packaging alone does not implement it.
The dashboard/browser and agent must access the same persistent task/memory files. Source relocation cannot provide that filesystem/UI integration.
